trigger: S1-v1 improved multiple roles but lost the D13 certificate because its zero-ranked unused routes were ordered before used routes
revision_mechanism: replace S1-v1's start-index score with rank s_k + (V+1)(1-a_k), where a_k is the depot-exit indicator; sort ranks nondecreasing
